scope: Read-only live Work navigation audit and revised static concepts. No product implementation.

steps.name: Open selected task's dependency map
steps.health: Scope coherent; fit-to-view makes long chains difficult to read.
steps.observation: Task #875 selected; map shows its seven tickets. Selected task belongs here.

steps.name: Switch to Stories task overview
steps.observation: Single-task selector persists above a multi-task overview. Selected task currently still matches details.

steps.name: Filter overview to Recently finished
steps.observation: Visible story changes to completed task #1078 Publish verified StackOS 2.1.40 updater artifacts. Top selector remains in-progress task #875 Publish Day 1 Q&A articles and resubmit sitemap.

steps.name: Open visible story's task details
steps.observation: Details panel opens #875 despite visible story being #1078.

code_findings.finding: Selected-task selector rendered for all current views.
Local story filters can fall back to a different story without updating parent task identity.
Open-details event omits displayed task identity.
router.replace means current task/view changes do not form a useful browser-back history.
Home ticket-count links currently point at Tickets view and need an intentional new destination.
Existing status filtering mixes task status and contained-ticket status.
Current live stream scopes to selected task; a project task board needs project-wide freshness.

limits: Board is proposed and not implemented in the live app.
Static concepts do not verify keyboard behavior, focus management, live updates, responsive overflow or save operations.
Image-generated styling is illustrative; implementation must use current StackOS components and tokens rather than tracing generated pixels.
